description: This data set provides simulated fault records for testing transmission line protection algorithms in a 500 kV power system modelled in the Alternative Transients Program (ATP). It was published by Giovanni Manassero Junior, Rodrigo Rozenblit Tiferes, Daniel Texidor Dantas and Marcos Paulo Simão Barros. The system has five buses in a ring joined by double-circuit lines with the Bergeron model; one bus holds a 2 GW nuclear plant with synchronous generation, another a 300 MW wind farm with doubly-fed induction generators, and the others are Thévenin equivalents. Instrument transformers modelled on real equipment, including saturating current transformers and capacitive voltage transformers, sit at both ends of the line from the wind farm to the nuclear plant, and files give primary and secondary voltages and currents for faults varied by location, inception angle, resistance, topology, signal noise and channel asymmetry. The method is location-independent as a generic test system. Files are downloadable, one per scenario, on Mendeley Data (2025) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the system is synthetic, and the authors say more details will follow. Simulation uses are testing protection schemes for grids with inverter-based generation, relevant to cascading failure and resilience studies. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
